verdict.rationale: PyAirbyte explicitly supports extracting data into local caches for prototyping in notebooks without running a server (docs-1, docs-47, docs-40), and Airbyte Core can be spun up locally in minutes via abctl/Docker for OSS testing (docs-12/16/31/37, docs-13), which together enable a local-first pipeline test workflow before promoting to production. However, there is no explicit doc on validating/promoting a tested pipeline into production, and a hands-on community report describes local docker-compose installation failing outright (airbyte-comm-1), undercutting the 'setup takes minutes' claim. Missing for 10: documented promote-to-production workflow, and independent corroboration that local lightweight-destination testing works smoothly end-to-end.
